title: Foundations of Screens and Devices: Protecting the Young Child from Birth
description: A cyber tarbiyah (upbringing) pathway covering the most important foundations for dealing with screens and devices for children up to one year old: zero screens under two years (AAP/WHO recommendation), alternatives of real play, protecting sleep and development, and the risks of early exposure to games and advertisements. Based on the guidelines of the American Academy of Pediatrics and the World Health Organization.

primary_reference.info: AAP Council on Communications and Media 2016 + WHO Guidelines on physical activity, sedentary behaviour and sleep for children under 5 (2019)
